sentences.text: Red Bull India Pvt. Ltd. & Anr vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on

Author: Shekhar B. Saraf
Bench: Shekhar B. Saraf
19.07.2023 ss W.P.A. 12165 of 2016 Red Bull India Pvt. Ltd. & anr.
Vs. State of West Bengal & ors.
< Mr. Dhilon Sengupta Mr. Shobhan Khanra Mr. Ayan Chakraborty

Mr. Abhixit Singh Ms. D. Chopra Ms. Sohini Mukherjee ... for the petitioners Mr. Tarak Karan ... for
the State
This writ petition filed by the petitioners relates to a challenge towards adjudication order passed under the Food and Safety Standard Act, 2006.
Petitioners submit that since a tribunal has been formed, this matter now is required to be transferred to the said tribunal.
In light of the same, the Registry is directed to have this matter transferred to the newly constituted Tribunal within a period of two weeks.
Subsisting interim order is extended for a period of ten weeks from date.
This writ petition being W.P.A. 12165 of 2016 is treated as disposed of and upon transferring the matter to the tribunal, the same is to be struck of from the ledger.

(Shekhar B. Saraf, J.)
